rfam.comment: Previously known as pfl RNA. ZMP is also known as AICAR. ZMP/ZTP riboswitch (pfl riboswitch)was first recognise by a comparative analysis [1] ZMP/ZTP riboswitch selectively binds ZMP and regulates genes associated with purine biosynthesis and one-carbon metabolism [3] The structure of ZMP/ZTP has been reported in [2,3,4,5,6,7]
